title: SENT TOMORROW · Part 3
gemini_style: scared teenage girl, close to the mic, tense and real

vo_open.text: The voice on the phone was mine. And it said: get out. Now.
vo_open.cap: The voice on the phone was *mine.* And it said: get *out.* *Now.*
vo_open.de: Die Stimme am Telefon war meine. Und sie sagte: Raus. Sofort.
vo_open.es: La voz del teléfono era la mía. Y dijo: sal. Ya.
vo_open.fr: La voix au téléphone, c’était la mienne. Et elle a dit : sors. Maintenant.
vo_open.tts: The voice on the phone was mine. <short pause> And it said... get out. NOW.

vo.text: Someone is in the elevator. Coming up to your floor. Take the stairs.
vo.cap: Someone is in the *elevator.* Coming up to *your* floor. Take the *stairs.*
vo.de: Jemand ist im Aufzug. Er kommt zu deinem Stockwerk. Nimm die Treppe.
vo.es: Alguien está en el ascensor. Sube a tu piso. Ve por las escaleras.
vo.fr: Quelqu’un est dans l’ascenseur. Il monte à ton étage. Prends l’escalier.
vo.style: fast urgent whisper, like giving orders

vo.text: So I ran. Six floors down. In my socks.
vo.cap: So I *ran.* Six floors *down.* In my *socks.*
vo.de: Also rannte ich. Sechs Stockwerke runter. In Socken.
vo.es: Así que corrí. Seis pisos abajo. En calcetines.
vo.fr: Alors j’ai couru. Six étages. En chaussettes.
vo.tts: <heavy breath> So I ran. Six floors down... in my socks.

vo.text: On the third floor, I saw Mom's car in the parking lot.
vo.cap: On the third floor, I saw *Mom's car* in the parking lot.
vo.de: Im dritten Stock sah ich Mamas Auto auf dem Parkplatz.
vo.es: En el tercer piso vi el coche de mamá en el aparcamiento.
vo.fr: Au troisième étage, j’ai vu la voiture de maman sur le parking.
vo.tts: <breath> On the third floor... I saw Mom's car in the parking lot.

vo.text: Then a voice from the stairs below. Maya? Come down, sweetie.
vo.cap: Then a voice from the stairs *below.* *Maya?* Come down, sweetie.
vo.de: Dann eine Stimme von unten. Maya? Komm runter, Schatz.
vo.es: Entonces una voz desde abajo. ¿Maya? Baja, cariño.
vo.fr: Puis une voix, plus bas dans l’escalier. Maya ? Descends, ma chérie.
vo.tts: Then a voice from the stairs below... <short pause> Maya? <short pause> Come down, sweetie.
vo.style: frightened whisper, then a warm, too calm mother voice

vo.text: And my own voice whispered: that's not Mom.
vo.cap: And my own voice whispered: that's *not* Mom.
vo.de: Und meine eigene Stimme flüsterte: Das ist nicht Mama.
vo.es: Y mi propia voz susurró: esa no es mamá.
vo.fr: Et ma propre voix a chuchoté : ce n’est pas maman.
vo.tts: And my own voice whispered... <short pause> that's NOT Mom.
